policy.former_formal_effective: The earlier semantic closed-loop clock is retained only as a supplemental audit field and is not the completion clock.
policy.stability: Continuous container lifetime is tracked separately and does not increase formal effective research time.

remediation_before_formal.included_work: Isolation repair, native Harbor runtime, official-paper reproduction, B/R/U recalibration, boundary checks, final image builds, and recovery archive streaming.

all_in_elapsed_before_formal.note: This elapsed work is included by the user-authorized policy; the authoritative point-in-time calculation starts at the same documented task timestamp and subtracts only confirmed no-connection intervals.

initial_controller_attempt.seed: First round closed as a no-op with zero eligible seconds, then failed while restoring the unchanged best because the trusted root process lacked DAC_OVERRIDE and wrote before using CAP_CHOWN.
initial_controller_attempt.gpt: First round was still incomplete when stopped so the already-loaded pre-fix controller could not later hit the same restore failure. A subsequent 17-second setup attempt exited before agent execution because Docker reused an IP whose dead peer record was cleaned after, rather than before, the launch; that attempt is also archived.
initial_controller_attempt.accounting: Both attempts remain in failed-attempts and contribute to total investment only; neither contributes formal effective time.

final_v8_formal.status: 10-hour research-time target satisfied for both tracks under the user-authorized policy; controllers paused after in-flight rounds; continuous-container stability remains pending
